title: Geometric invertibility for every normalized external cup cochain map
statement: Let k be a field, X,Y quasi-compact k-schemes with affine diagonals and F,G quasi-coherent modules. Use the scalar resolution models of [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model]. For every given cochain map c:Tot(A tensor B) -> C satisfying IsPicardExternalCupCochain of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain], HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c n is an isomorphism in every natural degree n. No cochain map, model or factor equivalence is constructed or selected by this statement.

source.place: Varieties Tag 0BED proof after equation 33.29.1.1: exact coefficient sequences, two dimension-shifting inductions and acyclic Leray base case

proof.text: Equip X and Y with the given k-structure morphisms. Use the existing uniform finite cohomological bound theorem to obtain nonnegative bounds dX and dY for all quasi-coherent coefficients on the two schemes.

Fix an acyclic F. Induct on the nonnegative bound d for G, generalizing over every quasi-coherent G with that bound, every normalized c, and every n. At d=0 use the acyclic base case. At d+1 apply the right coefficient successor theorem with the full bound-d induction hypothesis. Evaluate at dY to prove the comparison for every G when F is acyclic.

Fix G. Induct on the nonnegative bound d for F, generalizing over every quasi-coherent F with that bound, every normalized c, and every n. At d=0 use the preceding acyclic-left result evaluated at dY. At d+1 apply the left coefficient successor theorem with the bound-d induction hypothesis. Evaluate at dX and the original F,c,n.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth; F1 implements the two bounded inductions in Lean, using the existing uniform bounds and three separate base/successor statements.

theorem picardExternalCupCochain_isIso
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (c : picardExternalTotal f g F G ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
    (hc : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F G c) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c (n : ℤ))
